protocol.name: owned-custom-native-controls-v1.1
protocol.transform: front0 identity; back90 T(x,y)=(40-y,40-x)mm; exact native world rings required. Y-symmetric shapes do not qualify arbitrary chiral reflection.
protocol.intrusion_predicate: Require nonexcluded same CONCAVE/FOREIGN_TRACK copper shorting_items or clearance error; allow at most one additional same-pair solder_mask_bridge error. Mask-only and unrelated errors fail. All raw findings retained.
